content.short: Webacy makes self-custody secure and easy, with no keys or seed phrases needed.
content.description: Webacy acts as a protective layer for self-custody, guiding you through often overlooked scenarios that can put life-changing sums at risk. It provides a clear plan of action if you click a malicious link or sign a suspicious transaction, helping you limit damage and regain control quickly. If the unexpected happens, you can rest easy knowing your crypto wealth can be passed down to your loved ones, and you’ll stay aware of any inbound or outbound activity in your wallets in real time.
content.meta: Webacy is the software protection layer for self-custody. Discover Webacy and other Web3 Wallet Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
